neighbours.label: the position just before the value of a ratio or proportion ('ratio is [2:1]', 'F/M = [4.5]', 'are as [1:5]')
fire: In the study, the ratio of boys to girls was 3:2 in every class.
The male-to-female ratio (M/F) = 1.8 in the treated group.
Mix the cement and sand in a ratio of 1:4 before adding water.
The proportion of left-handed students is 12/96 = 0.125.
The odds ratio for smokers was 2.3 compared with non-smokers.
Teachers to pupils stood at a ratio of 1 to 25 last year.
The aspect ratio of the screen is 16:9, as on most televisions.
The weights of the two gases are as 1:8, nearly.
quiet: In the study, there were 30 boys and 20 girls in every class.
The treated group had 18 men and 10 women in total.
Mix the cement and sand for 4 minutes before adding water.
There are 96 students and 12 of them are left-handed.
The smokers in the study were aged 40 to 65 years.
Each teacher had 25 pupils in the class last year.
The screen is 55 inches wide, as on most televisions.
The two gases weigh 2 grams and 16 grams, nearly.

notes: Card: peaks on ' ' in 'F/M = 4.5', ' as' in 'weights are as 1:5', '==' in a ratio assert, '为' in Chinese '...之比为100:87', '=' in '8/32=0.25'. Near misses keep numbers but not a ratio.
